title: User Interface Friendliness
summary: Feedback on the G70 user interface centers on ease of use, with clear praise for dashboard and system usability, clear complaints about unintuitive or inconvenient interactions, and many fragments that are too vague or narrowly descriptive to assign a firm sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the vehicle interface and dashboard layout as easy to use and satisfying to operate.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe the interface or related processes as difficult to use, not intuitive, or not user-friendly.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention user-friendliness, user profiles, interface operation, or connection issues, but several are too brief, ambiguous, or inconsistently labeled to support a firm sentiment summary.

limitations: Most fragments are labeled undetermined, which limits confidence in a more specific sentiment characterization.
The cluster includes related but not fully uniform subjects such as interface usability, app/process usability, stored user profiles, and phone-to-interface connection issues.
Some examples are extremely brief or lack context, so they cannot support detailed aspect-level conclusions.
